description.en: Rav Ketina was a highly respected teacher in Babylonia and his teachings are brought down by several rabbis such as Rav Chisda.
description.he: רב קטינא היה רב מוערך בבבל. דבריו נמסרים מפי רבנים שונים דוגמת רב חסדא.
